verdict.rationale: Marqeta docs show velocity/authorization spend controls (docs-5, docs-6), transaction retrieval (docs-7), webhooks for event notifications (docs-9), and a disputes API for handling compromised-card claims (docs-8) — these provide some fraud-adjacent tooling. However, there is no evidence of network fraud scores or Marqeta's own fraud-risk models surfaced at authorization time, no dedicated suspicious-activity/fraud alerting feature, and no explicit card-block-and-reissue workflow described. Missing for 10: fraud score/model surfaced at auth, suspicious-activity alerting, explicit block-and-reissue tooling for compromised cards.
